A tinted callout in a rail or above a table: a Dot, a title in the tone's colour, an optional
body and one action. It loads with the page and is not dismissed; it goes when it is no longer
true. Feedback after an act is a toast, and a message about the whole site is a Banner.

aria-multiselectable-cfebf9a39743.name: aria-multiselectable
documentation: Indicates that the user may select more than one item from the current selectable descendants.

aria-orientation-ab2aeb0d2faf.name: aria-orientation
documentation: Indicates whether the element's orientation is horizontal, vertical, or unknown/ambiguous.

aria-owns-fde9d0ba7db5.name: aria-owns
documentation:
Identifies an element (or elements) in order to define a visual, functional, or contextual parent/child relationship
between DOM elements where the DOM hierarchy cannot be used to represent the relationship.

aria-placeholder-a0408aa9c015.name: aria-placeholder
documentation:
Defines a short hint (a word or short phrase) intended to aid the user with data entry when the control has no value.
A hint could be a sample value or a brief description of the expected format.

aria-posinset-dcb9bd0f86db.name: aria-posinset
documentation: Defines an element's number or position in the current set of listitems or treeitems. Not required if all elements in the set are present in the DOM.

aria-pressed-e4fedc38616e.name: aria-pressed
documentation: Indicates the current "pressed" state of toggle buttons.

aria-readonly-bdabb38198d6.name: aria-readonly
documentation: Indicates that the element is not editable, but is otherwise operable.

aria-relevant-19f1236576a4.name: aria-relevant
type: "text" | "all" | "additions" | "additions removals" | "additions text" | "removals" | "removals additions" | "removals text" | "text additions" | "text removals" | undefined
documentation: Indicates what notifications the user agent will trigger when the accessibility tree within a live region is modified.

aria-required-bfc0a6591534.name: aria-required
documentation: Indicates that user input is required on the element before a form may be submitted.

aria-roledescription-5a7c1349d472.name: aria-roledescription
documentation: Defines a human-readable, author-localized description for the role of an element.

aria-rowcount-051ccd0e70d6.name: aria-rowcount
documentation: Defines the total number of rows in a table, grid, or treegrid.

aria-rowindex-14ff39273236.name: aria-rowindex
documentation: Defines an element's row index or position with respect to the total number of rows within a table, grid, or treegrid.

aria-rowindextext-beef0d66d363.name: aria-rowindextext
documentation: Defines a human readable text alternative of aria-rowindex.

aria-rowspan-f767ef482d98.name: aria-rowspan
documentation: Defines the number of rows spanned by a cell or gridcell within a table, grid, or treegrid.

aria-selected-ef6eba8d9de0.name: aria-selected
documentation: Indicates the current "selected" state of various widgets.

aria-setsize-a7fb0db87513.name: aria-setsize
documentation: Defines the number of items in the current set of listitems or treeitems. Not required if all elements in the set are present in the DOM.

aria-sort-95a96cbb58cd.name: aria-sort
documentation: Indicates if items in a table or grid are sorted in ascending or descending order.

aria-valuemax-01989bd65718.name: aria-valuemax
documentation: Defines the maximum allowed value for a range widget.

aria-valuemin-1ac998d8220e.name: aria-valuemin
documentation: Defines the minimum allowed value for a range widget.

aria-valuenow-c388f3057c2c.name: aria-valuenow
documentation: Defines the current value for a range widget.

aria-valuetext-42f866fdc16c.name: aria-valuetext
documentation: Defines the human readable text alternative of aria-valuenow for a range widget.

autoFocus-74005ca91d53.name: autoFocus
documentation:
When a selection mode is set, DayPicker will focus the first selected day
(if set) or today's date (if not disabled).

Use this prop when you need to focus DayPicker after a user action, for
improved accessibility.

broadcastCalendar-703f1faf32f3.name: broadcastCalendar
documentation:
Display the weeks in the month following the broadcast calendar. Setting
this prop will ignore {@link weekStartsOn} (always Monday) and
{@link showOutsideDays} will default to true.

captionLayout-3f71334b69ad.name: captionLayout
documentation:
Show dropdowns to navigate between months or years.

- `label`: Displays the month and year as a label. Default value.
- `dropdown`: Displays dropdowns for both month and year navigation.
- `dropdown-months`: Displays a dropdown only for the month navigation.
- `dropdown-years`: Displays a dropdown only for the year navigation.

**Note:** By default, showing the dropdown will set the {@link startMonth}
to 100 years ago and {@link endMonth} to the end of the current year. You
can override this behavior by explicitly setting `startMonth` and
`endMonth`.

classNames-5cfc86831c60.name: classNames
documentation:
Change the class names used by DayPicker.

Use this prop when you need to change the default class names — for
example, when importing the style via CSS modules or when using a CSS
framework.

collapsible-fe3a65df8c74.name: collapsible
documentation: Whether an accordion item can be collapsed after it has been opened.

components-d5c7fb2c55ee.name: components
documentation: Change the components used for rendering the calendar elements.

dateLib-0563a0a82dd9.name: dateLib
documentation:
Replace the default date library with a custom one. Experimental: not
guaranteed to be stable (may not respect semver).

defaultMonth-4ebce461742f.name: defaultMonth
documentation:
The initial month to show in the calendar.

Use this prop to let DayPicker control the current month. If you need to
set the month programmatically, use {@link month} and {@link onMonthChange}.

disabled-354cbce8ca7e.name: disabled
documentation: Whether this item is currently disabled.

disabled-40c2f87a4de3.name: disabled
documentation: Whether or not an accordion item is disabled from user interaction.

disabled-8a66ef31ba24.name: disabled
documentation: Whether or not an accordion is disabled from user interaction.

disabled-9d45d2fd95c1.name: disabled
documentation:
Apply the `disabled` modifier to the matching days. Disabled days cannot be
selected when in a selection mode is set.

disableNavigation-f11fad6bcd6d.name: disableNavigation
documentation:
Disable the navigation between months. This prop won't hide the navigation:
to hide the navigation, use {@link hideNavigation}.

disablePointerSelection-69c9f0bf78f3.name: disablePointerSelection
documentation: Optionally set to `true` to disable selection via pointer events.

endMonth-6dbba7b25223.name: endMonth
documentation: The latest month to end the month navigation.

excludeDisabled-f994bb381f8d.name: excludeDisabled
documentation: When `true`, the range will reset when including a disabled day.

filter-b23338218406.name: filter
documentation:
Custom filter function for whether each command menu item should matches the given search query.
It should return a number between 0 and 1, with 1 being the best match and 0 being hidden entirely.
By default, uses the `command-score` library.

firstWeekContainsDate-89b0e8981756.name: firstWeekContainsDate
documentation: The day of January that is always in the first week of the year.

fixedWeeks-108162d1b9c8.name: fixedWeeks
documentation:
Display always 6 weeks per each month, regardless of the month’s number of
weeks. Weeks will be filled with the days from the next month.

footer-23df2daca758.name: footer
documentation:
Add a footer to the calendar, acting as a live region.

Use this prop to communicate the calendar's status to screen readers.
Prefer strings over complex UI elements.

forceMount-7602d4616e6f.name: forceMount
documentation: Whether this group is forcibly rendered regardless of filtering.

forceMount-984bc4952a8f.name: forceMount
documentation: Whether this item is forcibly rendered regardless of filtering.

forceMount-c3142f16bf0c.name: forceMount
documentation:
Used to force mounting when more control is needed. Useful when
controlling animation with React animation libraries.

formatters-ccd81380e9df.name: formatters
documentation:
Formatters used to format dates to strings. Use this prop to override the
default functions.

heading-196b331c9217.name: heading
documentation: Optional heading to render for this group.

hidden-51c0c3774803.name: hidden
documentation:
Apply the `hidden` modifier to the matching days. Will hide them from the
calendar.

hideNavigation-e8dc6a8e3a80.name: hideNavigation
documentation:
Hide the navigation buttons. This prop won't disable the navigation: to
disable the navigation, use {@link disableNavigation}.

hideWeekdays-248059b5c8b1.name: hideWeekdays
documentation: Hide the row displaying the weekday row header.

inputMode-e099a3be620f.name: inputMode
documentation: Hints at the type of data that might be entered by the user while editing the element or its contents

is-1780ad5b99bd.name: is
documentation: Specify that a standard HTML element should behave like a defined custom built-in element

ISOWeek-f4b47b9b4f27.name: ISOWeek
documentation:
Use ISO week dates instead of the locale setting. Setting this prop will
ignore `weekStartsOn` and `firstWeekContainsDate`.

keywords-0b5b01727b53.name: keywords
documentation: Optional keywords to match against when filtering.

label-2b4021eaaf01.name: label
documentation: Accessible label for this loading progressbar. Not shown visibly.

label-c258a56898e1.name: label
documentation: Accessible label for this List of suggestions. Not shown visibly.

label-cb7aa6f0104b.name: label
documentation: Accessible label for this command menu. Not shown visibly.

labels-59989681a3a5.name: labels
documentation:
Labels creators to override the defaults. Use this prop to customize the
aria-label attributes in DayPicker.

lang-fe759238e168.name: lang
documentation:
Add the language tag to the container element.

When omitted, DayPicker uses the active locale code (`locale.code`). Set
this prop to override the language tag.

locale-366f900f0854.name: locale
documentation:
The locale object used to localize dates. Pass a locale from
`react-day-picker/locale` to localize the calendar.

loop-27a8e267dec8.name: loop
documentation: Optionally set to `true` to turn on looping around when using the arrow keys.

max-b0b2cf1a8ffe.name: max
documentation: The maximum number of selectable days.
The maximum number of days to include in the range.

min-e6b202da2b2a.name: min
documentation: The minimum number of selectable days.
The minimum number of days to include in the range.

mode-df3309d3f67a.name: mode
documentation: Enable the selection of a single day, multiple days, or a range of days.

modifiers-3b4670b898e6.name: modifiers
documentation: Add modifiers to the matching days.

modifiersClassNames-fb017fffeb4f.name: modifiersClassNames
documentation: Change the class name for the day matching the `modifiers`.

modifiersStyles-5f86e79b1413.name: modifiersStyles
documentation: Change the class name for the day matching the {@link modifiers}.

month-abb7fad224ef.name: month
documentation:
The month displayed in the calendar.

As opposed to `defaultMonth`, use this prop with `onMonthChange` to change
the month programmatically.

navLayout-185af2908d4c.name: navLayout
documentation:
Adjust the positioning of the navigation buttons.

- `around`: Displays the buttons on either side of the caption.
- `after`: Displays the buttons after the caption. This ensures the tab order
  matches the visual order.

If not set, DayPicker preserves its legacy layout, but the tab order may
not align with the visual order when using `captionLayout="dropdown"`.

nonce-8a9c55538feb.name: nonce
documentation:
A cryptographic nonce ("number used once") which can be used by Content
Security Policy for the inline `style` attributes.

noonSafe-a8b16a1c3ea6.name: noonSafe
documentation:
Keep calendar math at noon in the configured {@link timeZone} to avoid
historical second-level offsets drifting dates across midnight.

This prop sets the time of the dates to noon (12:00).

numberOfMonths-eac67b8d6b2f.name: numberOfMonths
documentation: The number of displayed months.

numerals-ba4f28214509.name: numerals
documentation:
The numeral system to use when formatting dates.

- `latn`: Latin (Western Arabic)
- `arab`: Arabic-Indic
- `arabext`: Eastern Arabic-Indic (Persian)
- `deva`: Devanagari
- `beng`: Bengali
- `guru`: Gurmukhi
- `gujr`: Gujarati
- `orya`: Oriya
- `tamldec`: Tamil
- `telu`: Telugu
- `knda`: Kannada
- `mlym`: Malayalam

onDayBlur-2ba617e51a7f.name: onDayBlur
documentation: Event handler when a day is blurred.

onDayClick-a3c910a3354d.name: onDayClick
documentation: Event handler when a day is clicked.

onDayFocus-ea4920b64e4b.name: onDayFocus
documentation: Event handler when a day is focused.

onDayKeyDown-bc22704dab2e.name: onDayKeyDown
documentation: Event handler when a key is pressed on a day.

onDayMouseEnter-b7302034c5ad.name: onDayMouseEnter
documentation: Event handler when the mouse enters a day.

onDayMouseLeave-3a21ae4049ac.name: onDayMouseLeave
documentation: Event handler when the mouse leaves a day.

onNextClick-c5ffd38f4a42.name: onNextClick
documentation: Event handler when the next month button is clicked.

onPrevClick-620c47b0900b.name: onPrevClick
documentation: Event handler when the previous month button is clicked.

orientation-f23250e37bf4.name: orientation
documentation: The layout in which the Accordion operates.

pagedNavigation-9c2d4934368b.name: pagedNavigation
documentation: Paginate the month navigation displaying the `numberOfMonths` at a time.

progress-0ef9f927b304.name: progress
documentation: Estimated progress of loading asynchronous options.

required-a8378f20565c.name: required
documentation: Whether the selection is required.

resetOnSelect-23b9cf6beab6.name: resetOnSelect
documentation:
When `true`, clicking a day starts a new range if there is no current start
date or if a range is already complete. In those cases, the clicked day
becomes the start of the new range. When `required` is `false`, clicking
the same day of a single-day range clears the selection.

When `true`, clicking a day starts a new range if there is no current start
date or if a range is already complete. In those cases, the clicked day
becomes the start of the new range.

reverseMonths-3b6fc8002bc8.name: reverseMonths
documentation:
Render the months in reversed order (when {@link numberOfMonths} is set) to
display the most recent month first.

reverseYears-904871325482.name: reverseYears
documentation:
Reverse the order of years in the dropdown when using
`captionLayout="dropdown"` or `captionLayout="dropdown-years"`.

shouldFilter-81660408c051.name: shouldFilter
documentation:
Optionally set to `false` to turn off the automatic filtering and sorting.
If `false`, you must conditionally render valid items based on the search query yourself.

showWeekNumber-4d5170bc0359.name: showWeekNumber
documentation:
Show the week numbers column. Weeks are numbered according to the local
week index.

startMonth-496051cc5bed.name: startMonth
documentation: The earliest month to start the month navigation.

styles-8bf020fe2657.name: styles
documentation: Change the inline styles of the HTML elements.

timeZone-0853a2f0dc6a.name: timeZone
documentation:
The time zone (IANA or UTC offset) to use in the calendar (experimental).

See
[Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_tz_database_time_zones)
for the possible values.

title-f50e3dc98248.name: title
documentation: Add a `title` attribute to the container element.

today-a113b65a5fd0.name: today
documentation:
The today’s date. Default is the current date. This date will get the
`today` modifier to style the day.

useAdditionalDayOfYearTokens-da3ac31f601.name: useAdditionalDayOfYearTokens
documentation:
Enable `YY` and `YYYY` for day of year tokens when formatting or parsing
dates.

useAdditionalWeekYearTokens-429a7d93d56c.name: useAdditionalWeekYearTokens
documentation:
Enable `DD` and `DDDD` for week year tokens when formatting or parsing
dates.

vimBindings-db21a289e909.name: vimBindings
documentation: Set to `false` to disable ctrl+n/j/p/k shortcuts. Defaults to `true`.

weekStartsOn-57013a3a1773.name: weekStartsOn
documentation:
The index of the first day of the week (0 - Sunday). Overrides the locale's
default.
